paused.description: Whether the marquee is currently paused.

orientation.description: The current orientation of the marquee.

side.description: The current side/direction of the marquee.

multiplier.description:
The multiplier for auto-fill. Indicates how many times to duplicate content.
When autoFill is enabled and content is smaller than container, this returns
the number of additional copies needed. Otherwise returns 1.

contentCount.description:
The total number of content elements to render (original + clones).
Use this value when rendering your content in a loop.

restart.description: Restart the marquee animation from the beginning.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the marquee. Useful for composition.

side.description: The side/direction the marquee scrolls towards.

speed.description: The speed of the marquee animation in pixels per second.

delay.description: The delay before the animation starts (in seconds).

loopCount.description: The number of times to loop the animation (0 = infinite).

autoFill.description: Whether to automatically duplicate content to fill the container.

pauseOnInteraction.description: Whether to pause the marquee on user interaction (hover, focus).

reverse.description: Whether to reverse the animation direction.

defaultPaused.description: Whether the marquee is paused by default.

onPauseChange.description: Function called when the pause status changes.

onLoopComplete.description: Function called when the marquee completes one loop iteration.

onComplete.description:
Function called when the marquee completes all loops and stops.
Only fires for finite loops (loopCount > 0).

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Viewport.data-side: The side of the trigger that the viewport is positioned on

Content.data-side: The side of the trigger that the content is positioned on

Edge.data-side: The side of the trigger that the edge is positioned on
